Metadata.description: Lumi Beta Works helps businesses of every size build fast, scalable websites and apps that hit the mark.

Hero.title: Websites and apps built with intent, from idea to launch.
Hero.subtitle: Lumi Beta Works helps your business — from a simple landing page to a fully custom system — built by a team that gets both the tech and your goals.

TrustedBy.heading: Trusted by businesses and institutions across industries

About.title: A Small Team That Likes Building Things Properly
About.body1: Lumi Beta Works is a small team that likes building things properly — from landing pages for local businesses to sorting out messy systems for government institutions. We're not here to sell buzzwords, just to build things people actually use.
About.body2: Got an idea (or even just a problem you can't quite name yet)? Let's talk.
About.pillar1Body: Clean code, modern Next.js/cloud architecture, and automated security practices for a platform that stays solid and easy to grow.
About.pillar2Body: Direct discussions without the red tape. Regular sprints, open work tracking, and proactive status updates every week.
About.pillar3Body: Focused on real business outcomes: higher conversion, lower bounce rates, and infrastructure that keeps operating costs down.

Services.title: Comprehensive Digital Engineering Solutions
Services.subtitle: From the first prototype to global production scale, we stay with you through every stage of your product's lifecycle.
Services.webDevBody: From landing pages to custom web and mobile apps, built with the right tech stack for the job — not just whatever's trending.
Services.uiuxBody: Research-driven interface design that's easy to use, not just nice to look at. We think through the user flow from day one, not patch it in later.
Services.qaBody: Manual and automated testing before launch, so bugs get caught by us — not by your users.
Services.consultingBody: Technical consulting to help you make the right call — choosing a tech stack, planning architecture, or just a second opinion before you build.

TechStack.title: Tech Stack We Work With
TechStack.subtitle: Picked based on what the project actually needs, not just what's trending.

Certifications.title: Proven Qualifications from Global Tech Leaders
Certifications.body: Every software solution and system architecture is built by engineers officially certified by premier programs from Google, Bangkit, Laskar AI, and Dicoding.

Pricing.subtitle: Pick the package that fits where your business is right now.

ServicesPage.title: Targeted Digital Engineering Solutions
ServicesPage.subtitle: Software engineering from planning to deployment, focused on genuine business needs without unnecessary complexity.
ServicesPage.service1Desc: Fast landing pages, internal dashboards, SaaS platforms, and custom web applications powered by Next.js and cloud infrastructure.
ServicesPage.service1Deliverables: Landing Pages, Custom Web Apps, Admin Dashboards, API & Database Integrations
ServicesPage.service2Desc: Intuitive and functional digital interfaces. User journeys mapped thoroughly from user research to production-ready Figma assets.
ServicesPage.service2Deliverables: Wireframing, High-Fidelity UI, Interactive Prototypes, Comprehensive Design Systems
ServicesPage.service3Desc: Rigorous manual and automated testing to ensure your software is stable, resilient, and virtually bug-free before launch.
ServicesPage.service3Deliverables: Manual Functional Testing, Test Automation (E2E), API Testing, Performance & Security Audits
ServicesPage.service4Desc: Clear technical consulting to choose the right stack, optimize codebases, or audit system readiness before scaling up.
ServicesPage.service4Deliverables: Tech Stack Assessment, Cloud Architecture, Refactoring Strategy, Security & Performance Review
ServicesPage.workflowSubtitle: A 4-step framework ensuring every project milestone is delivered on schedule and to specification.
ServicesPage.step1Desc: Deep-dive discussions to understand product objectives, target users, and technical constraints.
ServicesPage.step2Desc: Drafting UI/UX wireframes, database schema, and project delivery milestones.
ServicesPage.step3Desc: Clean code implementation backed by automated testing to verify system reliability.
ServicesPage.step4Desc: Production launch, complete system documentation, and post-release warranty support.
ServicesPage.ctaSubtitle: Explore package options on our pricelist page or discuss your ideas directly with our engineering team.

AboutPage.title: Where Ideas Become Real Products
AboutPage.subtitle: From a freelancer daring to experiment into a dedicated technology studio ready to engineer your digital solutions.
AboutPage.storyP1: Lumi Beta Works started from a personal freelancer with a dream to grow by building an independent tech business. In our early days, most of our clients were MSMEs with remarkable enthusiasm for digital transformation.
AboutPage.storyP2: Even though we now handle corporate and enterprise projects, we will never forget our roots. We continue providing accessible, dependable, and high-impact technology solutions for MSMEs.
AboutPage.pillarLumiDesc: The light of an idea. The spark behind every digital innovation.
AboutPage.pillarBetaDesc: The courage to experiment, test, and relentlessly refine solutions.
AboutPage.pillarWorksDesc: Turning ideas into real, functional, and high-value digital products.
AboutPage.val1Desc: Clean code, modern Next.js/Cloud architectures, and robust security practices for maintainable systems.
AboutPage.val2Desc: Direct discussions without red tape. Regular sprint updates, open task tracking, and proactive reports.
AboutPage.val3Desc: More than just clean visuals: systems engineered to streamline operations, cut overhead, and drive conversions.
AboutPage.ctaTitle: Have an Idea or Need Technical Guidance?
AboutPage.ctaSubtitle: Speak directly with our engineering team with no upfront obligation.
